summary: Direct Floquet analysis of the forced jet orbit at Re = 2000: one real multiplier, -1.1577, outside the unit circle (period doubling); the other converged multipliers lie inside.
description: Krylov-Schur (k_dim = 128, mode 3.11) on the map that takes a perturbation of the forced orbit to its value after one forcing period, T = 1 / 0.6. The orbit is the one of 210_baseflow_newton. Spectre_Hd.dat holds the 128 Ritz values with their residuals; Spectre_Hd_conv.dat holds the converged multipliers by decreasing modulus, and Spectre_NSd_conv.dat the same as growth rate sigma = ln|mu| / T and frequency. 81 of the 128 Ritz values meet the tolerance 1e-6 in the first Krylov cycle; the leading one has a residual of 3e-16. The orbit closes to 4.6e-5 in the relative velocity norm (printed as Orbit closure in logfile). The leading multiplier is real and negative: the orbit is unstable by period doubling, with sigma = 0.0878. The mode norms are those of the mode files written by the solver, whose normalisation does not change between runs. The values are those of the run named under produced.

leading_multiplier.note: Real part of the leading Floquet multiplier; it is negative, so the instability doubles the period.

leading_sigma.note: Growth rate ln|mu| / T of the leading multiplier.

second_multiplier.note: Next converged multiplier, real and inside the unit circle.

third_multiplier_real.note: Real part of the first complex pair.

leading_mode_vx_norm.note: Norm of the axial velocity of the leading mode; its sign is arbitrary, the norm is not.

leading_mode_vy_norm.note: Norm of the radial velocity of the leading mode.
